data.content_ref: inline:This conjecture is compatible with SRC_010: a suspended node is re-examinable only through a fresh edge-construction pass that commits new warrants, and the RESIDUE diagnostic of SRC_009 is exactly the trigger for that pass — because RESIDUE records which accepted attacker kept the node out, it names the warrant that a fresh pass would have to attack, so re-examination through new warrants is directed rather than arbitrary. REFUTED IF one exhibits a suspended node whose RESIDUE names an attacker that a fresh warrant-committing pass could not possibly attack, or if a node with insufficient_defense suspend_reason is re-examinable in a way that violates SRC_010's fresh-pass constraint.
